welcome_lead: Trace the neuron, the synapse and the endocrine system.
meta_desc: GCSE Psychology adventure on neurons, synapses and the endocrine system at work.
final_note: You can describe the journey of a signal from neuron to organ.

concepts.def: Carries signals from receptors to the CNS.
Carries signals from CNS to muscles.
Links sensory and motor neurons in CNS.

walkthroughs.body_html: Sensory neurons carry messages from receptors to the CNS. Motor neurons send commands to muscles. Relay neurons connect the two inside the CNS, allowing information to be processed.

An electrical impulse reaches the axon terminal and triggers release of neurotransmitters into the synaptic gap. These bind to receptors on the next neuron, creating a new impulse. The signal can be excitatory or inhibitory.

The hypothalamus signals the pituitary, which signals the adrenal glands to release adrenaline. Heart rate, breathing and blood sugar rise, preparing the body for fight-or-flight. Slower than nerves, but longer lasting.
